data.name: Photogrammetry Scan
data.description: We offer advanced Dental Photogrammetry and 3D Face Scan solutions to deliver ultra-accurate implant positioning and natural smile design. Our technology ensures high precision, fast scanning, and reliable full-arch data, perfectly matching intraoral scans with facial anatomy. This results in improved accuracy, reduced chair time, and predictable esthetic outcomes for implant and prosthetic cases
data.detailedDescription:
Photogrammetry scanning is an advanced digital technique used to capture the exact three-dimensional position of dental implants with extremely high accuracy. Unlike conventional impression methods, photogrammetry relies on calibrated multi-angle imaging to record implant locations without distortion caused by materials, movement, or scanning stitching errors.

This technology is especially valuable for full-arch implant restorations, where even minor positional inaccuracies can lead to misfit, mechanical stress, or long-term complications. By directly capturing implant spatial relationships, photogrammetry ensures a passive fit of frameworks and prosthetics, reducing chair time, remakes, and adjustments. It enhances predictability and improves overall treatment efficiency for both clinicians and laboratories.
